description: Tecno has worked with Digital Trends to explore how its EllaClaw AI agent could fit into professional content workflows. The collaboration includes tools that can gather information from selected sources, organise research into usable material and adapt generated content based on a user's previous writing. EllaClaw can also assess content for platform-specific publishing concerns. The workflows are designed for content professionals, while users retain the ability to review, modify and approve AI-generated material before anything is published.
title: Tecno EllaClaw Gets Customised Workflows for Research, Scripts and Social Media

description: Star Wars Zero Company, the turn-based tactics title from developer Bit Reactor, is estimated to have sold 1 million copies since it launched in August. Nearly 70 percent of the game's sales is said to have come on Steam. Star Wars Zero Company is also estimated to have generated $50 million in revenue.
title: Star Wars Zero Company Is Estimated to Have Sold 1 Million Copies Since Launch

description: OpenAI has introduced GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna as lower-cost additions to its latest model family. The new models are available through ChatGPT Work, Codex and the API, with Luna also accessible to Free and Go users through the desktop app. Their API pricing is 50 percent lower than the promotional rates of their GPT-5.6 counterparts. OpenAI says Sol and Luna improve results across professional tasks, coding and computer use, while also reducing errors and producing clearer responses with less jargon.
title: OpenAI Launches GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna With Lower Prices, Improved Performance

description: BitMEX has shut down its crypto trading services following a strategy review by parent company HDR Global Trading. Trading, deposits, and new positions are no longer available, but users can continue withdrawing their balances. The exchange is also applying security measures during the withdrawal process and has introduced an account fee for eligible KYC-verified users who maintain balances on the platform.
title: BitMEX Halts Crypto Trading, but Keeps Withdrawals Open Following Closure

description: iQOO will launch the iQOO 16, iQOO Pad Ultra and iQOO Gaming Headset in China on September 29. The smartphone and tablet will use the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 SoC and iQOO's Q4 gaming chip, which supports 2K resolution at up to 165fps. The iQOO 16 will also feature a Samsung M16 AMOLED display with LEAD 2.0 technology, up to 10,000 nits local peak brightness and 3,300Hz PWM dimming. It will be offered in three colour options.
title: iQOO 16, iQOO Pad Ultra Confirmed to Get Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 SoC

description: Google appears to be testing a redesigned interface for its Messages app. The latest Google Messages beta reportedly changes the placement of Gemini, Search and Start chat buttons. This suggests that Google is experimenting with a different navigation layout for the messaging app. The redesigned interface is not currently available to all users.
title: Google Messages Could Get a Redesigned Interface With Gemini and Search Changes

description: For the iPhone Duo, Apple didn't stretch iOS; it rebuilt it for the fold.
title: iPhone Duo First Impressions: The Real Star Isn't the Fold, It's the UI

description: Apple is working on prototypes of a screenless wearable focused on health and fitness tracking, according to a recent report. The device could feature a fabric wristband and a sensor-equipped computing module, with no display. The project has reportedly received support from senior Apple executives, including Tim Cook and Eddy Cue. Apple has not decided whether to release the product. The company is also adding more health-focused features to the Apple Watch and Health app as dedicated fitness wearables continue to grow.
title: Apple Screenless Fitness Tracker Could Rival Whoop, Launch May Come in 2028: Report

description: Soon after launching the X500, X500 Pro, and X500 Pro Max in China, the company revealed the timeline for the X500 Ultra’s launch. Vivo told another publication that it will announce the flagship X500 Ultra in China next year. Vivo did not reveal details about the X500 series' global availability.
title: Vivo Confirms X500 Ultra Will Be Launched Next Year: Report

description: Apple will reportedly host another event in October, during which the Cupertino company might launch new devices. First, the company could launch the new iPad Mini (2026), which might arrive with either the Apple A20 Pro or Apple A19 Pro chipset. The iPad Mini (2026) is also expected to sport an OLED display, similar to iPhone models, along with a new speaker system without holes and a water-resistant design. Next, this year could also witness the debut of the new iMac (2026) from Apple, which will reportedly be powered by the M6 processor. The iMac (2026) is said to also ship in new colour options and sport a 24-inch display.
title: Apple Could Host October Event After iPhone 18 Pro Launch, New Home Devices Tipped

description: Vivo Y600i could launch soon, as the handset has now been spotted on the China Telecom listing with renders and key specifications. The upcoming Y-series smartphone is listed in three colour options and two RAM and storage configurations. It could feature an 8,000mAh battery. The Vivo Y600i is expected to run on a Snapdragon 4 Gen 2 chipset.
title: Vivo Y600i Spotted on China Telecom With 6.87-Inch Display and Snapdragon Chipset

description: Battlegrounds Mobile India (BGMI) is closing out its latest content cycle with one final drop. This means players have one last opportunity to get their hands on free rewards and in-game items before the current run comes to an end. The latest batch arrives alongside the game's 4.6 Update, which introduced the Midnight Hunters theme mode, brought back Ocean Odyssey, and is set to add more India-first content. The September 23 drop brings the Golden Miramar Pan as its highlight reward, alongside other in-game items.
title: BGMI Final Redeem Code Drop: How to Get Golden Miramar Pan and Other Free Rewards

description: Activision is set to develop the next Halo game after major studio restructuring at Xbox. Now, the Call of Duty maker has said it wants to make "the greatest Halo game ever." Halo Studios, which suffered from significant layoffs, will now work to support the Halo community and other Xbox projects.
title: Activision Says It Wants to Make 'The Greatest Halo Game Ever' as Xbox Hands Franchise to Call of Duty Maker

description: Bitcoin is holding above $86,000 after a sharp weekly recovery, with improving institutional demand and broader risk appetite supporting momentum. Analysts are watching the upcoming Trump-Xi summit as a potential catalyst, while rising leverage and profit-taking could add volatility. Bitcoin’s ability to hold above the $83,000-$85,000 zone will be important for the recovery.
title: Bitcoin Holds Above $86,000 as Trump-Xi Summit Emerges as Key Market Catalyst

description: OnePlus 16 will be powered by the new octa-core Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 chipset from Qualcomm, which is built on a 2nm process, the company has announced. The chipset features three efficiency cores, three performance cores, and two prime cores, delivering a peak clock speed of 5.0GHz. The company has announced that the SoC will be paired with the “Wind Chaser Gaming Kernel” (translated from Chinese). The new architecture will allow the OnePlus 16 to deliver up to 185 fps gaming.
title: OnePlus 16 Confirmed to Feature Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 SoC; a New Gaming Phone for India in Works

description: Oppo has introduced the Enco X4 true wireless stereo earbuds in China with a dual-driver audio setup and support for multiple audio codecs. The earbuds offer several active noise cancellation modes, including an adaptive option, along with four microphones for calls. They support Bluetooth 6.1 and can connect to two devices at once. The charging case supports wired and wireless charging, while the earbuds carry an IP55 rating. Oppo claims up to 53 hours of total playback with the charging case.
title: Oppo Enco X4 Launched With ANC, Spatial Audio and Up to 53 Hours of Battery Life: Price, Features

description: Lava Virat Power reportedly spotted in the IMEI database. The listing does not show any specifications for the phone, but it suggests that the handset is currently in internal testing. It is likely to arrive as a budget offering. The Lava Virat Power could offer 4G connectivity. Lava recently launched the Virat Curve 5G in India with a 6,000mAh battery and a mini rear display.
title: Lava Virat Power Reportedly Spotted on IMEI Database, Launch Seems Imminent

description: The Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI) has introduced new rules requiring telecom operators to offer voice-and-SMS-only Special Tariff Vouchers (STVs) across shorter validity periods. This means telecom users who do not need mobile data could soon get more flexibility when choosing prepaid recharge plans. The regulator has also specified monthly-renewable plans and longer-validity options, potentially providing consumers with more choices instead of having to pay for bundled data services.
title: TRAI Mandates Shorter Voice, SMS-Only Recharge Plans With Lower Tariffs

description: Vivo X500 series will be launched in select global markets on October 27 at 4 pm CET (8:30 pm IST), according to a dedicated microsite on the Vivo Austria website. The Vivo X500, Vivo X500 Pro, and Vivo X500 Pro Max will be available for pre-order in the region on the same day as their launch. Meanwhile, the phones will go on sale in the EU on November 5. Apart from this, the Vivo X500 Pro Max, Vivo X500 Pro, and Vivo X500 have been listed on the European Product Registry for Energy Labelling (EPREL) database with the model numbers V2610, V2621, and V2622, respectively. The Vivo X500 Pro Max has been listed with a 6,570mAh battery, which could be marketed as a 6,800mAh battery.
title: Vivo X500 Series Confirmed to Launch Globally Late Next Month; Might Debut With Smaller Batteries

description: Coinbase has introduced fixed-rate, fixed-term USDC loans backed by Bitcoin, offering an alternative to its existing floating-rate borrowing option. The product operates through Morpho Midnight, a decentralised lending protocol built on Coinbase’s Base network. Borrowers can determine their interest costs and repayment dates upfront, while the existing Morpho Blue-based loans continue to use rates that fluctuate with market conditions.
title: Coinbase Introduces Fixed-Rate Bitcoin Loans, Giving Users an Alternative to Floating Rates

description: Oppo Watch S2 has been launched in China as the company's latest smartwatch. It is scheduled to go on sale in the country on September 24 via the Oppo China online store. The new wearable will be available for purchase in three colour options, namely “Vibrant Orange”, “Misty Powder”, and “Mountain Shadow Grey” (translated from Chinese). The Oppo Watch S2 also gets the new FatMax “Super Fat Burning Mode”, which provides real-time guidance during exercise to maintain efficient fat burning, while also calculating fat-burning efficiency, fat burned during exercise, and glucose consumed.
title: Oppo Watch S2 Launched With Up to 10 Days of Battery Life and New FatMax Mode: Price, Specifications

description: Nvidia's Isaac ROS 5.0 brings AI agents into open-source robotics development through reusable skills and agent-ready documentation. The release includes tools for robot setup, manipulation and model customisation, along with new capabilities for FoundationStereo and FoundationPose. Nvidia has also added support for ROS Lyrical and Ubuntu 24.04, plus a standard data-handling interface for different computing hardware. The latest version supports Nvidia's Jetson Orin Nano and Jetson Thor platforms, allowing developers to take robotics applications from development to deployment.
title: Nvidia Launches Isaac ROS 5.0 With AI Agents and Reusable Robotics Workflows

description: Samsung is said to have increased the prices of the Galaxy S26 series in India. According to a tipster, the South Korean tech conglomerate’s flagship smartphones now cost up to Rs. 25,000 more than their earlier prices. The price revision affects the Galaxy S26, Galaxy S26+, and Galaxy S26 Ultra across several storage configurations. The steepest increase is seen on the Galaxy S26 Ultra's 1TB variant. The move follows similar price adjustments across the South Korean tech conglomerate's mid-range Galaxy A and Galaxy F lineups.
title: Samsung Galaxy S26 Series Price in India Allegedly Hiked by Up to Rs. 25,000, Now Starts at Rs. 1,02,999

description: Vivo S2 FE will be launched in India alongside the Vivo V80, a tipster claims. Apart from this, the leaker has shared two images of the purported Vivo S2 FE, showing the phone in black and green colour options. Further, the leaker claims that the Vivo S2 FE could be priced in India under Rs. 40,000. In terms of specifications, the Vivo S2 FE will reportedly sport a 6.83-inch 1.5K AMOLED display, delivering up to a 120Hz refresh rate. An octa-core MediaTek Dimensity 7300e 5G chipset is said to power the new Vivo S2 series smartphone. It might also feature LPDDR4x RAM and UFS 3.1 onboard storage. The handset might ship with IP68 + IP69 ratings for dust and water resistance.
title: Vivo S2 FE Could Launch in India Alongside the Vivo V80; Price, Key Specifications Tipped

description: Bitpace has integrated Fireblocks into its payments infrastructure to support stablecoin transfers, multi-currency treasury management, and cross-border settlements. The service is aimed at businesses and merchants, with Fireblocks providing transaction controls, security features, and custodial infrastructure. Fireblocks said stablecoins accounted for 69 percent of its digital asset transaction volume in the second quarter of 2026.
title: Bitpace Brings Fireblocks Onboard for Stablecoin Settlements

description: Eligible new and existing Asus customers are confirmed to get three months of Google AI Pro or Google AI Plus at no extra cost. This offer covers select Asus and ROG laptops launched in 2025 and 2026 and models scheduled to launch next year. Eligible customers get 3 months of Google AI Pro with 5TB or Google AI Plus with 400GB cloud storage at no extra cost.  This special offer is confirmed to be available from August 10, 2026, through August 9, 2027
title: Select Asus and ROG Laptops Get 3-Month Google AI Pro, AI Plus Subscription in India

description: Xiaomi 18 Pro and Xiaomi 18 Pro Max have been launched in China, retaining a similar design to their predecessors. The new smartphones will be available for purchase soon via the Xiaomi China online store in three distinct colour options. Moreover, the Xiaomi 18 Pro series features a secondary rear display and a triple rear camera unit. The Xiaomi 18 Pro Max sports a 6.9-inch AMOLED display, while the Xiaomi 18 Pro features a 6.4-inch AMOLED display. Both phones come with the new Privacy Display feature. The Xiaomi 18 Pro Max is powered by the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 chipset.
title: Xiaomi 18 Pro Max, Xiaomi 18 Pro Launched With Up to 2nm Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 SoC, Privacy Display

description: Xbox has announced a new round of layoffs and widespread studio restructuring that will see the Halo franchise mode hands from Halo Studios to Activision. Xbox said 268 workers will be laid off across Halo Studios and other first-party studios.
title: Xbox Reset Continues With More Layoffs and Major Studio Restructuring; Activision to Make Next Halo Game

description: Oppo K14 Plus 5G is confirmed to launch on September 29 in India. It will run on the MediaTek Dimensity 7360 Max chipset and will have an IP69K rating for dust and water resistance. The upcoming phone will come with a 50-megapixel main rear camera with OIS support and 4K video recording. It will have an 8,000mAh battery. It is confirmed to feature an AMOLED panel and a 16-megapixel Sony IMX480 front-facing camera.
title: Oppo K14 Plus 5G India Launch Date Announced; Key Specifications Teased

description: Apple’s new Mac mini and Mac Studio are now available for purchase in India. They were announced in August as the latest addition to the Cupertino-based tech giant’s compact desktop lineup. The new Mac mini is powered by the M6 and M5 Pro chips, while the Mac Studio is available with the M5 Max and M5 Ultra silicon. Both models also run macOS 27 and come with Apple Intelligence features, including Siri AI. Apple says the new desktops offer support for demanding workloads such as agentic AI, video production, software development, and 3D rendering.
title: Mac Mini M6, Mac Studio With M5 Max and M5 Ultra Chips Go on Sale in India: Price, Specifications

description: The European System of Central Banks has proposed replacing MiCA’s minimum bank deposit requirement for stablecoin reserves with liquidity-based criteria. The recommendation would allow issuers to use instruments such as overnight reverse repos and short-term sovereign bonds to meet liquidity needs. The ESCB also raised concerns about non-compliant crypto firms continuing to serve customers in the European Union.
title: ECB, EU Central Banks Call for Revisions to MiCA Stablecoin Deposit Requirement

description: Unlike regular smart glasses, Viture’s Vonder smart glasses are focused on privacy and comfort. The glasses have no cameras, displays or even always-on recording. Vonder takes a more privacy-focused approach, letting users record audio only when needed.
title: Viture Vonder Smart Glasses Debut With AI Memories, Encryption and Prescription Lens Support

description: Adobe has launched Premiere for Android, bringing its mobile video editor to devices running Android 13 or later. The app supports multi-track and frame-accurate editing, creator-made templates, audio enhancement and Firefly-powered generative AI features. Users can import media, use Adobe Stock assets and export projects at up to 4K resolution. Adobe offers the core editing tools for free, while additional generative credits and storage require payment. The company also plans to add captions, keyframes, beat detection and desktop editing support.
title: Adobe Premiere Now Available on Android With Multi-Track Editing, 4K Export, AI Tools

description: Anthropic has officially announced Claude Opus 5.5. The new model, available starting September 22, is claimed to reduce overall operational costs by 40 percent compared to its predecessor. The company says Opus 5.5 completed a software migration involving around 6,80,000 lines of code in less than a day during a test. Claude Opus 5.5 is claimed to operate at up to 2.5 times the speed in fast mode and needs substantially fewer tokens to complete complex tasks.
title: Anthropic Claude Opus 5.5 Unveiled With Faster Performance, Lower Cost Compared to Claude Opus 5

description: Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 and Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 chipsets have been launched by Qualcomm as its next-generation flagship mobile platforms. Built on a 2nm process, the chipsets will power the upcoming flagship smartphones from various OEMs, including Honor, iQOO, Motorola, OnePlus, Oppo, Redmi, RedMagic, Vivo, and Xiaomi, the chipmaker said. The new Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 series is claimed to deliver enhanced on-device AI capabilities, along with improved gaming, camera, and connectivity performance.
title: Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6, Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Built on a 2nm Process Launched With Enhanced AI Capabilities

description: The ongoing AI-driven hardware crisis means the ROG Zephyrus G16 has breached the Rs. 4 lakh barrier in India. And without major upgrades, Asus' new line of gaming laptops becomes harder to recommend, especially when last year's models, which come with the same RTX 50 series GPUs, are available at a much lower price.
title: Asus ROG Zephyrus G16 (2026) Review: Minor Upgrades, Major Hike

description: Motorola Signature 27 was unveiled at the Snapdragon Summit 2026 on Tuesday. The handset arrives as the second model in the brand’s Signature series, following the debut of the Motorola Signature earlier this year. The new flagship is among the first smartphones announced with Qualcomm’s latest Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 chipset. It features a 50-megapixel Sony LYTIA 910 main camera and a 200-megapixel periscope telephoto camera. Motorola has also introduced a new naming approach with the Signature 27, using the final two digits of the upcoming year to distinguish generations.
title: Motorola Signature 27 Unveiled With Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6, 200-Megapixel Telephoto Camera

description: Beats 360 have been launched in India and global markets as the company’s latest flagship over-ear headphones. The headphones feature interchangeable ear and headband cushions, allowing users to change both the colour and material of the cushioning. The Apple-owned company says it has focused on delivering improved customisation alongside upgraded audio and noise cancellation capabilities. Beats 360 come with Active Noise Cancellation, Transparency mode, personalised spatial audio with dynamic head tracking, and an IPX4 rating.
title: Beats 360 Headphones Launched With Interchangeable Cushions, 32 Hours of Battery Life: Price, Specifications
